data.name: Sovereign Strike: Submarine Supremacy
data.detailed_description:
Sovereign Strike: Submarine Supremacy is a tactical submarine simulator. It is designed for players who crave thrilling naval combat without the burden of thick technical manuals.

You are the captain of a powerful Los Angeles-class nuclear attack submarine. Your mission is straightforward and addictive: hunt down and destroy enemy fleets, climb the global rankings, and bring glory to your nation.

Choose your side and battleground:

  • Small lake — for fast, intense skirmishes

  • Vast open sea — for epic, large-scale confrontations

Every location is based on real-world sites — from the crystal-clear waters of Crater Lake(USA) to the stunning depths of the Red Sea.

Select your adversary and strike without warning. The more enemy tonnage you send to the ocean floor, the higher you and your nation rise in the worldwide rankings — while your rivals sink in defeat.

Appear where you are least expected. Launch devastating torpedo salvos, then slip away into the safety of the depths. But the enemy is no pushover: their fleets include heavily armed warships, lightning-fast patrol boats, and cunning enemy submarines that can hunt you even in the darkest waters. Stay alert — even when you think you're safe, depth charges may still rain down from above.

Master your arsenal wisely:

  • Heavy torpedoes to crush cruisers and destroyers

  • Plasma torpedoes to stop high-speed vessels in their tracks

  • Light torpedoes for versatile finishing blows

When the battle ends, the ocean becomes your playground. Explore a living underwater world filled with wonders and secrets:

  • Encounter prehistoric sea monsters

  • Discover shipwrecks from violent storms and historic wars

  • Find crashed aircraft that never reached their destinations

  • Unearth entire submerged cities hidden from the surface world

Get close enough, and you’ll uncover exactly how these relics met their fate. Curious where the remains of Saint Matthew or Genghis Khan rest? The depths hold many surprises.

Key Features

  • Intuitive tactical submarine control

  • Real-time naval battles with high tension

  • Real-world locations from around the globe

  • Unique underwater artifacts and historical wrecks

  • Dynamic campaign where your actions shape the rankings

  • Realistic day-night cycles that affect visibility and tactics

data.short_description: Become the captain of a Los Angeles-class attack submarine. Strike without warning, sink enemy ships with different torpedoes, dominate the global rankings, and explore a living underwater world packed with historical wrecks and forgotten secrets. Fast, tactical, and fun submarine warfare.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core 5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 5070 12GB or AMD Radeon RX 9070 / RX 9060 XT 16GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
